name: dreamrefactory

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspaces --if-present

description: The CyberFlix DreamFactory engine, reimplemented, and the games that run on it. A workspace: engine/, taoot/, dust/, timelapse/, skullcracker/, site/, plus the tools any rip can use.
//scripts: Nothing here names a game. Cross-cutting work fans out over the workspaces (`--if-present`, so a package opts in by having the script), and each package's own commands live in its own package.json — run one with `-w <package>`, e.g. `npm run dev -w taoot`.
